description: LK Nova, a variable display typeface by Louis Kaiser. Nine axes. Original geometric outlines.
intro: A variable grotesk for headlines and branding. Nine axes control weight, proportions and individual letterforms.
character: Straight stems, rounded curves and tightly spaced headlines.
use: Designed for branding, digital products and print. Pair with a readable text face for interfaces and longer passages.
preview: Typeface preview; scroll horizontally when needed
copy_fallback: CSS selected. Press Ctrl+C or ⌘C to copy.
reduced: Reduced motion is enabled. Adjust the sliders manually.
alt_o: O outline with its construction curves
alt_k: K outline with connected diagonal strokes
alt_a: a outline with its upper construction curves
geometry: Rectangles define the stems; rounded contours define the bowls. Tangent transitions join the curves. Optical overshoot aligns rounded and flat forms.
alphabet: Uppercase and lowercase letters share the same proportions and construction principles. Λ and Ξ are separate characters for LOUIS KΛISΞR; A and E remain unchanged.
square_description: The character ■ sits on the baseline. MARK changes its size from 10 to 40% of cap height. It stays square across the other axes.
origin_description: LK Nova was developed for Louis Kaiser’s brand identity. Helvetica Neue was a visual reference for its bold grotesk proportions and tight spacing.
original_outlines: The outlines were constructed independently from geometric shapes and refined through successive reviews of curves, counters, numerals and joins. No third-party font outlines are included.
coverage: Latin letters, additional European characters, numerals, punctuation and selected symbols, including Λ, Ξ, ⇒ and ■.
install_description: Install Desktop/Variable/LKNova-VF.ttf with Font Book on macOS or Install on Windows. Use the six static weights for applications without variable-font support. Install either the variable or static family to avoid duplicate entries.
settings_description: Weight 900, width 100, upright, tracking −0.05 em (−50 in 1/1000-em units). LK Nova is a display face; use a separate text face for longer reading.
web_description: Keep font.css beside LKNova-VF.woff2 and apply the lk-display class. Variable-axis and color-font support depend on the application. A red square SVG is included as an alternative. Animation examples respect reduced-motion preferences.
license_description: Free personal and commercial use, including installation, embedding, modification and redistribution. No attribution, royalties or per-seat fees. The font license does not grant rights to the LOUIS KΛISΞR brand.
